description: This file defines the Message class, which manages message objects such as info and error messages, including storing, retrieving, and deleting them in a session context within the Goteo application.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: A class representing a message with type and content, providing static methods for creating, retrieving, and deleting messages stored in session.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a message object with type and content, and stores it in session.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes this message instance from session.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates info messages, accepting a string or array of strings.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates error messages, accepting a string or array of strings.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Retrieves all messages of a specified type, optionally auto-expiring after retrieval.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Retrieves all error messages, optionally auto-expiring.
